exact_statement: A minimizer of L(s) is a maximizer of E(s).

quantifiers.scorer: every measurable real-valued scorer s attaining inf_s L(s)
quantifiers.function_class: all measurable s: X x Y -> R

well_posedness_audit: p_x+ and p_x- admit densities on a common measurable support
the likelihood ratio p_x+/p_x- is positive and finite almost everywhere
the log-partition and risks are finite
acceptance_criteria: The checker verifies L(s)-L* = tau E_x KL(p_x+ || q_x,s).
An exact pairwise exchange certificate proves this ordering maximizes E.
Exact rational exhaustive checks pass for every positive integer distribution in the declared finite audit domain.
The reversed-order negative control exits nonzero for the intended reason.
The historical 5/12 baseline integrity suite still passes.

verdict_rule.FALSIFIED: A counterexample satisfies every well-posedness condition and has a loss minimizer that is not an E maximizer.
verdict_rule.BLOCKED: The symbolic certificate or independent checker is incomplete.

non_circularity: The proof uses no formula-derived sample size, fitted tolerance, or stochastic success criterion.
